coverage_issues: qwen model failed to evaluate PKGBUILD due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError), leaving it unassessed.
learnings: Implement automatic retries or fallback models for transient LLM API errors (like HTTP 400) to prevent incomplete audits and false inconclusive verdicts.
Ensure the audit tool clearly distinguishes between 'inconclusive due to tool failure' and 'inconclusive due to suspicious unanalyzable code' in its final reporting.
